## What it checks (sampled describe/it titles)

- TSNEAlgorithm.embed — happy paths
- HAPPY: 2 well-separated clusters in 4-D embed to 2-D — intra-cluster distance < inter-cluster
- HAPPY: dims=3 produces 3-D embedding
- HAPPY: embedding is centered at origin (mean ≈ 0)
- DETERMINISM: same seed → same embedding + iterations
- HAPPY: iterations returned matches maxIter
